verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents creating datasets and running an application on a dataset to produce an experiment. It also publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 API "to programmatically create and manage LangSmith resources", multi-language SDKs, and an official MCP server, so agent-driven creation and triggering are plausible first-party paths. However, the pack never explicitly shows programmatic retrieval of experiment or eval results, and never shows which operations the MCP server exposes. missing for 10: explicit docs for reading back experiment/eval scores via API/SDK, documented MCP tools for datasets and experiments, hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results

citations.quote: Create a dataset with examples from manually curated test cases, historical production traces, or synthetic data generation.
Execute your application on the dataset to create an experiment.
The LangSmith API is used to programmatically create and manage LangSmith resources
integrate LangSmith with any agent stack using our Python, Typescript, Go, or Java SDKs
